Trace, implement and test: 76.Longest Increasing Subsequence henrytien

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
// https://www.lintcode.com/problem/longest-increasing-subsequence/description

class Solution {
public:
    /**
     * @param nums: An integer array
     * @return: The length of LIS (longest increasing subsequence)
     */
    int longestIncreasingSubsequence(vector<int> &nums) {
        multiset<int> s;
        for(auto num : nums){
           s.insert(num);
           auto pos = s.lower_bound(num);
           if(++pos != s.end()) s.erase(pos);
        }
        return s.size();
    }
};

// dp version
class Solution {
public:
    /**
     * @param nums: An integer array
     * @return: The length of LIS (longest increasing subsequence)
     */
    int longestIncreasingSubsequence(vector<int> &nums) {
       
       vector<int> dp(nums.size(),0);
       int ans = 0;
       for(int i = 0; i < nums.size(); ++i){
           dp[i] = 1;
           for(int j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--){
               if(nums[j] < nums[i]) dp[i] = max(dp[i],dp[j] + 1);
           }
           ans = max(ans,dp[i]);
       }
       return ans;
    }
};
